## Historical audit — S0149

**Scope:** Only chunk 2 is visible. All citations refer to the original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/scene_rsi_pilot/C2/selection/commons_133800864/trajectory.jsonl`. Character ranges below are the supplied observation ranges, not finer-grained offsets.

| Evidence | Observed operations and limits |
|---|---|
| Goal and construction | The requested goal was an editable reconstruction of a single indoor RGB image, not a calibrated recovery. The student’s program constructed multiple semantic owners: architecture, blinds, cabinet, towel and ring, sink, faucet, blender, jug and pitcher, among others. It grouped brackets, handles and other parts under owners; those code relationships do not prove physical contact. [S0149, line 22, model_request, characters 0–155107] |
| Autonomous revision | After step 1, the student estimated compressed foreground separation and an overly square cabinet view, then changed camera position, target and lens for step 2 while retaining scene geometry. These are student visual diagnoses, not independently checked measurements. [line 22, characters 0–155107] |
| Appearance and pose | The student judged step 2 too pale and changed broad material colors and the procedural counter shader for step 3, retaining the step-2 camera, object geometry and lighting. The code specifies object placements and poses, including a tilted blender jar; it does not establish their accuracy. [line 22, characters 0–155107] |
| Validation and outcome | Runner messages report `ok: true` and saved renders for steps 1–3; the first two execution elapsed times were reported as 5.577 and 5.597 seconds, not isolated render timings. With execution budget exhausted, the student replied `SELECT 3`; the selection event records step 3. This is operational success and a recorded selection, not formal visual or geometric correctness. [line 22, characters 0–155107; line 24, model_response, characters 0–353; line 25, select, characters 0–59] |
| Input and exploration | The visible student request included system procedure, render-comparison prompts and scheduling evidence. No separately identified teacher detection, diagnosis or proposed update appears in this chunk, so teacher receipt or adoption cannot be established. The final selection session was read-only, with tools disabled and zero tool calls; the iterative programs and runner results are visible in its supplied history. [line 22, characters 0–155107; line 23, codex_session, characters 0–4324] |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Separating camera and appearance revisions and preserving semantic owners are transferable practices; the particular coordinates, colors and camera settings are scene-specific hypotheses. The student predicted improved framing and contrast, but the images themselves are not visible to this audit. Thus actual inventory visibility, texture appearance, connections, support, occlusion, pose, camera match, shadows and lighting remain unverified. The code and successful renders do not establish collision accuracy or regression-test success; no technical interruption or algorithm failure is shown in the visible chunk. Earlier unseen evidence and any independent evaluation remain unknown.
